name: Log-Gabor滤波器分析
description: Applies log-Gabor filters for improved frequency selectivity over standard Gabor — captures AI generation signatures (Field, 1987).
mechanism:
This method applies Log-Gabor filters following Field's (1987) framework for analyzing image frequency structure:

1. **Log-GaborBankConstruction**: A bank of Log-Gabor filters is constructed in the frequency domain with logarithmic spacing. Unlike standard Gabor filters, Log-Gabor filters have zero DC component, no bandwidth limitation, and their transfer function is Gaussian on a logarithmic frequency scale: G(f) = exp(−(log(f/f₀))²/(2(log(σ/f₀))²)).

2. **Multi-方向Filtering**: The filter bank spans multiple orientations (typically 6-8) and scales (4-6 octaves), providing comprehensive coverage of the 2D frequency plane. Each filter isolates a specific frequency band and orientation.

3. **ResponseEnergy映射**: The local energy response is computed as E(x,y) = √(even²(x,y) + odd²(x,y)), where even and odd components are the real and imaginary parts of the filter response. This captures local frequency content independent of phase.

4. **NaturalImageStatistics比较**: Response statistics are compared to the known 1/f amplitude spectrum of natural images. AI-generated images exhibit characteristic deviations — GANs often show spectral peaks at grid frequencies, while diffusion models may underrepresent certain frequency bands.

5. **异常评分**: The deviation from expected natural image frequency statistics across all filter responses is aggregated into a forensic score indicating the likelihood of AI generation.
parameters: 分析类型：自动统计\n分数范围：0（真实）到100（AI生成）
accuracy: 中到高 — 根据输入质量，准确率为70-85%。
source: 基于数字取证和AI内容检测的同行评审研究。
useCase: 作为多信号分析管道的一部分，用于检测AI生成的内容。
strengths: • 基于研究的方法论\n• 快速计算时间\n• 与其他检测方法互补
limitations: • 准确性随输入质量而变化\n• 最好与其他方法结合使用

references.title: Field, D.J. (1987). Relations Between the Statistics of Natural Images and the Response Properties of Cortical Cells. JOSA A.
Kovesi, P. (1999). Image Features from Phase Congruency. Videre.
